definitions.explanation: Clothes worn for sleeping, including both Western-style pajamas and traditional Japanese nightwear (yukata-style).

examples.japanese: {寝巻|ねまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
{寝巻|ねまき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
{寝巻|ねまき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まま→まま：02460_mama⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ないで→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go outside in your sleepwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寝巻|ねまき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{用意|ようい}されている→用意：01746_youi⟧。
examples.english: At the ryokan, a yukata is provided as sleepwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：10079_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{寝巻|ねまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ってもらって→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were happy to get new sleepwear.

notes:
{寝巻|ねまき} is a native Japanese word for sleepwear. It can refer to both traditional Japanese nightwear (like yukata) and Western-style pajamas.

Alternate forms:
- {寝間着|ねまき} - alternate kanji spelling (same pronunciation)

Related words:
- パジャマ - pajamas (Western-style, loanword)
- {浴衣|ゆかた} - yukata (often used as sleepwear at ryokan)
- ナイトウェア - nightwear (modern loanword)
